errors.error_description: Introduced unintended latch inference by assigning dout_reg only when en_decode is true in a combinational always block without an else or default assignment.
Declared a net using an escaped identifier \logic to reuse the reserved keyword 'logic' as a signal name.
Added an extra state S_UNUSED in the enum that is never transitioned into, creating an unreachable state.
Implemented opcode decoding with a long nested ternary expression, producing a deep combinational path that is suboptimal for synthesis.
